*PharmaCraft Daily - 21 Nov 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Antiviral/Fungal/Protozoal/Helminth)
Q: Which drug is a first-line antifungal for systemic candidiasis?
Ans: Fluconazole
Why: Fluconazole inhibits fungal CYP-dependent ergosterol synthesis; used for candidiasis and cryptococcosis.

🌍 *FMGE* (Antiviral/Fungal/Protozoal/Helminth)
Q: ACT (artemisinin-based combination therapy) is first-line for?
Ans: Falciparum malaria
Why: Artemisinin-based combination therapy is the recommended first-line treatment for P. falciparum malaria.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Antiviral/Fungal/Protozoal/Helminth)
Q: Dolutegravir inhibits which HIV enzyme?
Ans: Integrase
Why: Dolutegravir is an integrase strand-transfer inhibitor, a preferred component of first-line ART.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Antiviral/Fungal/Protozoal/Helminth)
Q: Which antifungal class is preferred for invasive candidiasis in unstable patients due to few interactions?
Ans: Echinocandins (caspofungin)
Why: Echinocandins are first-line for invasive candidiasis: fungicidal with few drug interactions.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Paper IV: Recent Advances)
Q: CAR-T cell therapies (e.g., tisagenlecleucel) are engineered to target?
Ans: CD19 on B-cell malignancies
Why: Approved CAR-T therapies target CD19 in refractory B-cell leukaemia/lymphoma.
